evals_reused_note: Origin ships evals/evals.json with 4 real cases (mode-routing scenarios). Reused as the basis for this entry's task-success cases; extended to 8 to cover more of the origin's own entry-router table (git safety, hook diagnosis modes weren't covered by the original 4).
live_dependency_note: Origin's own evals already operate against a local repository state (git status, remotes, hooks) rather than a live external service. No rewrite needed for self-containment.
